run_bundle_adjustment: run bundle adjustment on RGB-D sequences with optional GP depth factors and pose noise
load_depth_cov_model: load a NonstationaryGpModule depth covariance model from a checkpoint file onto a device
run_depth_model_inference: run the depth covariance model on a list of RGB images to get Gaussian covariance outputs
detect_and_track_features: detect and track 2D keypoints across a sequence of RGB images using Lucas-Kanade optical flow
triangulate_landmarks: triangulate 3D landmark points from 2D keypoints and initial camera poses using GTSAM
